_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Custom Microcircuit Procurement Plan
summary: This plan documents the delivery, test, and production schedules for each microcircuit vendor producing custom integrated circuits for the contract.
use_relationship:
This plan shall document the delivery, test, and production schedules for each microcircuit vendor producing custom integrated circuits for this contract.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data generated by the specific and discrete task requirements outlined in the contract. The term microcircuit or custom microcircuit, as used in this data item shall refer to both custom integrated circuits and hybrid microcircuits unless otherwise indicated.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall include the following;

children.title: Title page that includes the contract name, contract number, contractor name, date of preparation, security classification, and document title.
Identification of the delivery, test, and production schedules for each microcircuit vendor producing the custom microcircuits.
children.content: The schedules shall be documented in either bar graph or calendar format.

children.title: Identification of the number of devices scheduled for delivery, test, and production each month the custom parts are procured.
